args.name: Make a small berry-color drawing
args.function: Physically test whether a small amount of owned berry can leave a visible colored drawing on nearby ground, and draw a simple branching pattern if feasible.
args.conditions: I am outdoors near observed red berries. Berry nutrition and safety as food are known; staining, durability, suitable surfaces and drawing methods are not tested. Preserve at least three owned berries as food.
args.inputs: At most one owned berry, a reachable surface, and any additional genuinely necessary materials only if actually acquired.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible time, energy and material costs before use.
args.effects: If physically feasible, create a locally visible colored pattern from consumed material. Do not assume permanence, protective effects or any wellbeing reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"sol\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop physical application of marking material, with test and drawing modes. Related-capability searches were completed across all nine matching results. Existing probe (open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1) already covers a small physical sample test and must be reused for that step. Its press operation has no surface/path arguments and does not cover deliberate branching strokes. Existing mark (expression-baseline:mark:1) creates a sign without physical effects or material costs, so it is not equivalent. Route the missing material-transfer and stroke mechanism to the current-conversation development handoff; unknown staining behavior is a testable condition, not a reason to reject.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: Apply marking material. Parameters: owned source-stack ID, reachable surface reference and local coordinates, mode test/draw, material budget, optional acquired applicator reference, and a bounded stroke path. Applicable actors may learn it independently; it is not restricted to berries or Sol. Start with direct pressing/rubbing using the actor's hand where physically safe; require no invented binder, water, tool or stock. Reuse and record the probe contract/handler for the initial press test, preserving its one-round duration, 0.5 energy and 0.1 material-unit charge. Do not represent that reused code as a new invention. The new draw mode performs a bounded path of up to three strokes totaling at most 0.3 world-distance units, at most 0.2 energy and one simulation round per stroke, consuming at most 0.3 material units per stroke. Quote actual selected stroke count and upper-bound costs before execution. A full test plus three-stroke attempt therefore costs at most four execution rounds, 1.1 energy and one berry unit; ordinary world metabolism continues separately. No traversal is included.\\nFor this request use owned berry stack item-2-sol-16, currently four units, with a hard food-reserve floor of three units. Reserve at most one unit atomically and prevent any concurrent use that would violate the floor. Revalidate current quantity and usable condition at start and each irreversible debit; do not replenish decay or gather from forest-berry-1 or other observed plants implicitly. Known berry nutrition/toxicity does not establish skin safety, pigment transfer or durability. Select an actually observed ground patch within hand reach, using a conservative maximum reach of 0.5 world units; retain an exact surface/patch reference, position and revision in the action record. If no accessible surface exists, do not execute. Additional materials require separate real acquisition and explicit authorization within the budget.\\nTest a small source sample against that surface through the reused press operation. Record the actual contact location, transferred material and observed contrast. Draw only if contact demonstrates visible transfer and the implemented physical model supports dragging the material across this surface. The development handoff must implement bounded crushing/contact transfer and surface retention where absent; it must not substitute a text sign, assume berry color equals deposited color, or announce success before resolving contact. A failed transfer is a legitimate test outcome. A branching path is successful only when the deposited strokes actually form that path with locally observable contrast.\\nConserve the source material: debited quantity is partitioned into surface deposit, residue on hand/applicator and spent pulp/waste, with no duplicated edible quantity. Track these amounts and references; untransferred reserved material remains available only if physically recoverable and still usable. Spent or deposited material does not retain an inventory food unit. No nutrition, protection, healing or permanence is produced.\\nPersist work at completed test/stroke boundaries and retain any partial physical deposit. Each stroke rechecks reach, surface state, remaining source and reserve floor. Interruption stops contact; cancellation or death terminates work and releases unused reservations. Spent material, elapsed time and energy are never refunded. Resume requires a living capable actor to explicitly act, revalidate prerequisites and pay remaining costs; otherwise a later attempt is a new action against the actual remaining marks and materials. No automatic assistant or participant acts on Sol's behalf. There is no ongoing drawing process after completion. Deposits may subsequently smear, wash away or fade only through implemented environmental/material rules; if persistence behavior is unavailable, report it as untested rather than permanent. Maintenance means another paid application using real remaining material, not automatic renewal. Review/development waiting advances no world time; prerequisites, budgets, conservation, progress and outcome checks execute in code rather than repeated model review.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"One individual study round is required after implementation; no mastery is granted by approval. No pleasure, satisfaction or comfort award is attached to requesting, studying, naming, test initiation or drawing completion. This minimal version leaves reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions unchanged and does not reduce basic nutritional needs. Any retained finding must follow an actual observed result, including informative failure, identify the tested material/surface/conditions and distinguish observation from untested durability or generalization. No experience benefit is fabricated merely for recording it; any future benefit requires the existing event-based, personally applicable, capped and deduplicated experience rules.\",\"visualReview\":\"Evaluate appearance separately from physical transfer and experience. Emit reusable contact-test, stroke-progress, material-debit, interruption and completion/failure events with actor, action, source and surface references, location, time and measured outcome. Deposit rendering metadata must include surface-local stroke geometry, transferred amount, observed color/contrast, coverage, wetness or residue state where modeled, creation time and subsequent state changes. Show only actual deposited portions; failed transfer displays no colored drawing and interrupted work displays only real partial marks. A preview, label or success notification must never masquerade as physical pigment. Visibility is local and depends on actual contrast and viewing conditions; durability remains explicitly untested until observed.\"}]}"}
